name: Geneva State Park Campground
evidence: Kept on --AWH firsthand note. OSIP leaf-off at 41.8548,-80.9895 with ReserveOhio per-site plot agrees: premium full-hookup 113, 114 (45-54 ft) ~8-15 m from the Lake Erie riprap over open lawn, no road between; 101-112 sit behind the loop road ~40-60 m; main loop wooded and far back.

name: Leafy Oaks Campground
evidence: Operator map (PDF p.2): sold 'Waterfront' sites 311-323 (CampLife, 29-34 ft, nightly) back onto the swim pond; Esri z19 at 41.2234,-83.0252: ~15 m of grass and roped sand swim beach to a ~0.6 ha pond. Beach is a used strip, too small for lakeview (cf. 15432). Fishing-pond row 531-549 is seasonal per the map; creek not at sites.

name: Mosquito Lake State Park
evidence: OSIP leaf-off at 41.3134,-80.7652 with ReserveOhio plot, plus Esri: electric 218-220 (35-40 ft, web-bookable) on the cul-de-sac's outer side, 218 ~10-15 m and 219 ~20 m from water with the road behind them; rig at the shore, weed mat then open lake. 210-212 ~13-17 m from the south cove. 66-69 ~40+ m behind trees; yurts don't count. Mid-lake, not near the dam.

name: Lazy Village Campground
evidence: Operator per-site map: Creek Sites 40-67 in a row against Turkey Creek, sold nightly at $40. Esri 38.7015,-83.0815, OSIP 38.7022,-83.0810 and operator drone photo: rigs between the lane and the ~25-35 m wide creek, ~15-20 m from the bank; lane behind them; grass with spaced trees, no continuous screen on the leaf-off frame.

name: Mohican State Park Campground
evidence: Stored call holds. ODNR per-site map draws river-side rows on the Clear Fork; fresh OSIP frame at 40.6098,-82.2662 with ReserveOhio plot: electric 85-86 (48 ft, web-bookable) and 87-92 along the bank, south of the park road, with no road between. Stored plot has 70-75, 85-86, 153 pad ends ~20-25 m from water.

name: Scioto Trail State Park
evidence: OSIP leaf-off at 39.2306,-82.9560 and 39.2301,-82.9545 with ReserveOhio plot: 41-55 on a side road 110-300 m north of Caldwell Lake, 1-40 further west; closest pads 10-13 ~55-90 m from the NW tip, in woods across the park road and launch lot; none faces it. Contradicts the stored '41-55 loop around the lake'.

name: Poor Farmer's Campground
evidence: Operator map and Campspot: 'Creekside-Back-in' 9-22, 26, 27, 33, 39, 40 (to 45 ft, $40 nightly) on Lost Creek's north bank, rigs ~10-20 m from the channel on OSIP 40.1322,-84.1020. But operator photos of those sites (post 17 legible) show a continuous brush and tree wall behind the pads, no water visible. Screened, as at Foxfire 1279.

name: South Bass Island State Park
evidence: Kept on --AWH firsthand note. OSIP leaf-off at 41.6452,-82.8381 and 41.6440,-82.8395 with ReserveOhio plot: the shoreline sites are Tent Only; closest RV pads 126, 129 (non-electric, 35 ft) ~40-50 m from shore through trees; electric/full block 100-250 m back in woods. My reading is lakeview at best, see flag.
